teaser: A library book, three months overdue, sits in your bag because returning it means admitting you are finished with it. Life path 9 is the number of letting go, and INTP is the type built to keep turning a question over long after most people would set it down. The crossing makes a particular kind of reluctance: the wish to release what no longer serves, paired with a mind that finds almost everything worth one more pass. What looks like detachment from outside can be unfinished analysis on the inside, still waiting for the last loose thread to resolve before anything gets put down.
